specs.name: netlib_dpotf2_u

target.note: cuSOLVER POTRF is blocked; same factorization, different rounding order than unblocked DPOTF2

assumptions: A is symmetric positive definite (INFO = 0 path)
only the upper triangle of A is referenced and overwritten
deviations: non-positive-definite exit removed: dpotf2.f L175-L178 IF (AJJ.LE.ZERO.OR.DISNAN(AJJ)) ... GO TO 30 (INFO=J)
IF (J.LT.N) guard around DGEMV/DSCAL removed (dpotf2.f L184): for J=N both calls have N-J=0 trips; exact
DDOT unit-stride 5-way unrolled loop (ddot.f L114-L128) replaced by its general-increment loop (ddot.f L134-L142); summation order identical, bitwise exact
DSCAL DA.EQ.ONE quick return removed (dscal.f L104); exact

target.note: cuSOLVER POTRF is blocked; same factorization, different rounding order than unblocked DPOTF2

assumptions: A is symmetric positive definite (INFO = 0 path)
only the lower triangle of A is referenced and overwritten

IF (J.LT.N) guard around DGEMV/DSCAL removed (dpotf2.f L209): for J=N both calls have N-J=0 trips; exact

layout_transpose.about: Declarative layout-transpose equivalences used by the region matcher's launch emitter. A binding that stores the listed rank-2 operands transposed (the spec reads op^T of the memory it is given) is equivalent to the spec whose defines have each listed flag flipped between its two values, with the listed argument pairs swapped (flips first, then swaps). Leading dimensions always follow their array. The transposed operand set must be covered exactly by disjoint rules.
